$note: Loops play muted inside the wing arches, round and round while their screen is active, with no pause control (the owner's choice, 26 October 2026): per wing an AV1 file for wide screens that decode it and an H.264 copy for phones and the rest, 960×1280 (3:4), each under 1.2 MB, made from the owner's MP4 previews (media/<wing>-loop-source.mp4, which do not ship) with tools/media/video_to_loop.py; the poster is media/<wing>-loop.jpg, the first frame; null keeps the poster. Films live on YouTube: links everywhere, played in place on the web build only (Artifacts cannot embed other sites). A film's "asset" is its URL in the Artifact's asset store (upload the MP4 to the published Artifact); with it the Artifact plays the film in its own popup instead of linking out. Covers are the case cover footage: per wing the owner's AV1 file (2560×1440) and an H.264 copy (1280×720), each under 1.2 MB; it loops while its cover is on screen, with no pause control (the owner's choice). The Artifact carries only the H.264 copies.
